findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 9 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 34 questions numbered 1-34; by section: 9.1 5, 9.1.1 7, 9.1.2 8, 9.1.3 7, 9.2 7.

Covers 9.1 (polynomials, long division), 9.1.1 remainder theorem, 9.1.2 factor theorem, 9.1.3 synthetic division and 9.2 applications in book order, with new polynomials; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed (f(a) = (a - a)q(a) + R in the proof of the remainder theorem). Every answer was checked by computation (sympy, check9.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
